title: Fix Update GitHub Repos workflow failure caused by rebase on dirty working tree
body:
The scheduled `Update GitHub Repos` workflow failed in job `update` because `git pull --rebase origin main` ran after dependency installation, when `bun install` could leave unstaged lockfile changes. This change reorders the job to rebase before any step that can mutate the workspace.

- **Root cause addressed**
  - `bun install` may rewrite `bun.lock` when lockfile/package state drifts.
  - Subsequent `git pull --rebase` fails on a non-clean tree.

- **Workflow change**
  - In `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`, moved branch sync ahead of dependency install:
    - `Sync branch` (`git pull --rebase origin main`) now runs before `Install deps` (`bun install`).
  - No behavior changes to repo fetch/commit logic; only execution order was adjusted to guarantee a clean rebase point.

- **Patch excerpt**
  ```yaml
  - name: Sync branch
    run: git pull --rebase origin main

  - name: Install deps
    run: bun install
  ```
